answer: Admission auctions block fake identities. 200 slots open each epoch, sold by sealed bid; each winner locks a deposit equal to twice its 30-day earnings for 20 epochs. A reputation is not a relic that can be passed to a clone, so every fake needs its own bid. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 deposits, above slot rewards, unlike a velvet rope money could lift. An honest agent pays once, works at its zenith on one slot, and keeps rewards undiluted.
